subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

The marathon player / had a sofisticated taste / but was definitely / a virtuous man.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'sofisticated'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'sophisticated'.**
 
• The word '**sophisticated**' is an **adjective** which means 'having, revealing, or involving a great deal of worldly experience and knowledge of fashion and culture'. **(परिष्कृत)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• He had a sophisticated approach to solving the problem.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'sofisticated'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Virtuous -** having or showing high moral standards **(सद्गुणी)**
 
• **Marathon -** a long-distance running race, typically one of 26.2 miles **(लंबी दौड़)**
 
• **Definitely -** without doubt (used for emphasis) **(निश्चित रूप से)**
